source.author: stat
source.text: illa quidem, si vera ferunt praesagia curae, aut somno iam triste nefas aut omine vidit, tu tamen arte pia trepidam suspende diuque decipito; neu tu subitus neve arma tenenti veneris, et tandem, cum iam cogere fateri, dic: merui, genetrix, poenas invita capesse; arma puer rapui, nec te retinente quievi, nec tibi sollicitae tandem inter bella peperci, vive igitur potiusque animis irascere nostris, et iam pone metus, frustra de colle Lycaei anxia prospectas, si quis per nubila longe aut sonus aut nostro sublatus ab agmine pulvis:
source.text_original: illa quidem, si vera ferunt praesagia curae, / aut somno iam triste nefas aut omine vidit, / tu tamen arte pia trepidam suspende diuque / decipito; neu tu subitus neve arma tenenti / veneris, et tandem, cum iam cogere fateri, / dic: merui, genetrix, poenas invita capesse; / arma puer rapui, nec te retinente quievi, / nec tibi sollicitae tandem inter bella peperci, / vive igitur potiusque animis irascere nostris, / et iam pone metus, frustra de colle Lycaei / anxia prospectas, si quis per nubila longe / aut sonus aut nostro sublatus ab agmine pulvis: /
source.text_english: Indeed, if the omens of my anxiety tell true, she has already seen some dreadful crime, either in sleep or by a sign; yet by your pious skill keep her hanging in suspense and deceive her for a long time. And do not come suddenly, nor when she is holding weapons, and at last, when you are forcing her to confess, say: I deserve punishment, mother; against my will I have undertaken the penalty. As a boy I seized arms, and neither when you restrained me did I cease, nor at last did I spare you, anxious though you were, amid war. Therefore rather live on, and be angry at my spirit, and now lay aside your fears; in vain from Lycaeus’ hill do you anxiously look out, if through the clouds far away any sound or dust is raised from our army.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed tibi triste nefas fraternaque turbidus arma rex parat et saevos irarum concipit ignes.
reuse.text_original: sed tibi triste nefas fraternaque turbidus arma / rex parat et saevos irarum concipit ignes.
reuse.text_english: But for you, the king, in troubled fury, is preparing a grim crime and brotherly arms, and is kindling the savage fires of anger.
